summary: This code creates a basic web API using FastAPI that listens for requests to the root URL path and responds with a JSON message. When someone visits the home page, the server returns a dictionary containing a greeting.

explanations.3: FastAPI() creates a new web application instance that will handle incoming HTTP requests and manage your API routes.
explanations.5: The @app.get("/") decorator tells FastAPI that the function below should run whenever someone makes a GET request to the root path of your website (the home page).
explanations.6: This function is automatically called by FastAPI when the route is accessed, and whatever it returns becomes the response sent back to the user.
